name: sdl-source-receipt
cmd: set -euo pipefail; OUT=$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR; bun install --frozen-lockfile > "$OUT/install.log" 2>&1; export SDL_CHECKED_ROOT="$PWD/sdl-checked" SDL_DEPENDENCY_ROOT="$PWD/sdl-prior"; bunx tsc -p research/bapa/tsconfig.sdl-transport.json > "$OUT/types.log" 2>&1; bun test research/bapa/sdl-source-verify.test.ts > "$OUT/tests.log" 2>&1; bun research/bapa/sdl-source-verify.ts sdl-checked sdl-prior "$OUT/SOURCE-CHECKED.json" > "$OUT/source-check.log" 2>&1; printf '%s\n' 'feat(bapa): transport decentralized lock and prove its source law' > "$OUT/commit-message.txt"; bunx @commitlint/cli --config research/egraph/historical/commitlint.config.cjs < "$OUT/commit-message.txt" > "$OUT/commitlint.log" 2>&1

name: sdl-broken-source
cmd: set -euo pipefail; ROOT=$PWD; OUT=$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR; bun install --frozen-lockfile > "$OUT/install.log" 2>&1; export PATH="$ROOT/scripts/lean-gate:$PATH"; export LEAN_PATH="$OUT:$ROOT/sdl-checked/rechecked:$ROOT/sdl-retained/lean/.lake/build/lib/lean:$ROOT/sdl-retained/lean"; bun research/bapa/sdl-source-data.ts --broken-source; cd "$OUT"; lean -o "$OUT/SdlSourceDefs.olean" "$OUT/SdlSourceDefs.lean" > "$OUT/defs.log" 2>&1; cp "$ROOT/research/bapa/SdlExactTransport.lean" "$OUT/"; lean -o "$OUT/SdlExactTransport.olean" "$OUT/SdlExactTransport.lean" > "$OUT/exact.log" 2>&1; cp "$ROOT/research/bapa/SdlSourceBridge.lean" "$OUT/"; set +e; lean "$OUT/SdlSourceBridge.lean" > "$OUT/broken-source.log" 2>&1; code=$?; set -e; test "$code" -ne 0; grep -q 'Tactic `rfl` failed' "$OUT/broken-source.log"; printf '%s\n' '{"brokenSource":"send keeps the lock","bridgeRefused":true}' > "$OUT/NEGATIVE-SOURCE.json"
